definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.166) 'One or more runtime modules that interact with one another and that function, at execution time, as an entity'; §2023:3.158 rewords it ('runtime entity ... independent entity'). The same entity; one EXCEPTION-OBJECT per run unit means the same.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:14.5.2.1.2.1 (initial state), 14.5.3 (transfers of control) and 14.5.10 (normal run unit termination); 2002 14.5.3 says 'paragraph' where 2023 says 'procedure', 2002 14.5.10 has the MCS purge item and lacks COMMIT and dynamic-table items, 2002 initial state also initializes the communication section. The rule matched only on 'run unit'; one instance of EXCEPTION-OBJECT does not rest on initial state, transfer of control or termination. No change; gl2m2_exception_object_identity at 2002 stands.
